rules: Open to current Penn State undergraduate and graduate students, staff, and faculty.
Requests are approved by the College of Engineering. You'll get an email if yours is approved.

verification.note: Rules are verified. Duration, increment and horizon are unpublished; numeric values are configurable defaults.

rules: Up to 3 hours per day per group.
Reservations are for two or more people, based on seating capacity.
Can be booked up to two weeks in advance.
Rooms are held for 15 minutes past the start time, then the reservation is forfeited.
Unreserved rooms are open for drop-in use.

verification.note: Minimum duration and 30-minute start increment are assumptions pending LibCal room configuration.
